tests.scenario: Validate free meditation sessions for non-subscribed users
steps: Launch the Calm app
Verify the user is not logged in or subscribed
Navigate to the meditation sessions library
tests.expected_result: The user can access at least 50 free meditation sessions

tests.scenario: Verify the monthly limit of free meditation sessions
steps: Launch the Calm app
Verify the user is not logged in or subscribed
Access 50 free meditation sessions
Attempt to access one more session
tests.expected_result: The user is prevented from accessing more than 50 free meditation sessions per month and is prompted to subscribe

tests.scenario: Validate free trial period for new users
steps: Launch the Calm app and navigate to the sign-up page
Sign up for a new account with a valid email address and password
Complete the onboarding process and access the premium content section
tests.expected_result: The app offers a free trial period of at least 7 days for new users to access premium meditation and sleep content

tests.scenario: Verify trial period duration
steps: Launch the Calm app and navigate to the account settings page
Verify the trial period start date and calculate the end date
Check if the premium content remains accessible during the trial period
tests.expected_result: The trial period is at least 7 days long and the premium content is accessible during this time

tests.scenario: Auto-stop after 30 minutes of inactivity
steps: Launch the Calm app and start playing a meditation session
Simulate 29 minutes of inactivity (e.g., no interactions, no screen changes)
Simulate 2 minutes of inactivity (i.e., 31 minutes total inactivity)
tests.expected_result: The meditation session stops playing automatically

tests.scenario: Content continues playing if user interacts within 30 minutes
steps: Launch the Calm app and start playing a sleep story
Simulate 25 minutes of inactivity
Simulate a user interaction (e.g., pause and resume the session)
Simulate an additional 5 minutes of inactivity
tests.expected_result: The sleep story continues playing after the interaction and does not stop automatically

tests.scenario: Auto-stop after 30 minutes of inactivity while playing content
steps: Launch the Calm app and start playing a meditation session
Simulate 30 minutes of inactivity (e.g., lock the screen, turn off the device, or switch to another app)
Verify the app's current state
tests.expected_result: The meditation session stops playing automatically

tests.scenario: Content continues playing if user interacts within 30 minutes
steps: Launch the Calm app and start playing a sleep story
Simulate 25 minutes of inactivity
Interact with the app (e.g., pause and resume the session)
Simulate an additional 5 minutes of inactivity
Verify the app's current state
tests.expected_result: The sleep story continues playing after the interaction and does not stop automatically until 30 minutes of inactivity have passed

tests.scenario: Validate pricing model transparency during onboarding
steps: Launch the Calm app and navigate to the onboarding process
Select a subscription plan and proceed to payment
Review the payment summary and terms
tests.expected_result: The app clearly displays the pricing details, including any trial periods, subscription lengths, and charges, with no unexpected fees.

tests.scenario: Verify no unexpected charges during onboarding
steps: Start the onboarding process and select a free trial option
After the trial period, proceed with the subscription without canceling
Verify the charges and subscription details
tests.expected_result: The app does not apply any charges during the onboarding process without explicit user consent, and the subscription details are transparent.

tests.scenario: Validate pricing model transparency during onboarding
steps: Launch the Calm app and navigate to the onboarding process
Select a subscription plan and proceed to payment
Review the payment summary and terms
tests.expected_result: The app clearly displays the pricing details, including any taxes or fees, with no unexpected charges

tests.scenario: Verify no hidden charges during onboarding
steps: Start the onboarding process and select a free trial option
After the trial period, attempt to upgrade to a paid subscription
Review the payment summary and terms before completing the upgrade
tests.expected_result: The app does not apply any unexpected charges or fees during the upgrade process

tests.scenario: Validate default meditation session duration
steps: Launch the Calm app
Navigate to the meditation session selection screen
Select a meditation session without specifying a duration
tests.expected_result: The meditation session starts with a default duration of 10 minutes

tests.scenario: Validate meditation session duration range
steps: Launch the Calm app
Navigate to the meditation session selection screen
Select a meditation session with a custom duration
tests.expected_result: The app allows selecting a meditation session duration between 5 and 20 minutes

tests.scenario: Validate default guided meditation session duration
steps: Launch the Calm app
Navigate to the meditation session selection screen
Select a guided meditation session without specifying a duration
tests.expected_result: The guided meditation session starts with a default duration of 10 minutes

tests.scenario: Validate guided meditation session duration range
steps: Launch the Calm app
Navigate to the meditation session selection screen
Select a guided meditation session with a custom duration of 15 minutes
tests.expected_result: The guided meditation session starts and lasts for 15 minutes, which is between 5 and 20 minutes

tests.scenario: Validate the number of guided meditation sessions
steps: Launch the Calm app
Navigate to the meditation library section
Count the number of guided meditation sessions available
tests.expected_result: The app displays at least 50 guided meditation sessions

tests.scenario: Validate the duration of guided meditation sessions
steps: Launch the Calm app
Navigate to the meditation library section
Select 5 random guided meditation sessions
Verify the duration of each selected session
tests.expected_result: All selected sessions have a duration between 5 and 30 minutes

tests.scenario: Validate the number of guided meditation sessions
steps: Launch the Calm app
Navigate to the meditation library section
Count the total number of guided meditation sessions available
tests.expected_result: The app displays at least 50 guided meditation sessions

tests.scenario: Validate the duration and variety of guided meditation sessions
steps: Launch the Calm app
Navigate to the meditation library section
Select 5 random meditation sessions
Verify the duration of each session
Verify the themes and narrators of each session
tests.expected_result: All selected sessions have durations between 5 and 60 minutes, and there is a variety of themes and narrators
